title: IUBMB Congress 2027
institution: International Union of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (IUBMB)
about: Call for abstracts for the IUBMB Congress 2027, 19-23 September 2027 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC), South Africa. Abstracts in ten topics, including bioinformatics, structural biology and infectious diseases, are due 12 February 2027.
card_alt: Card for the IUBMB Congress 2027 by the International Union of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (IUBMB), in Cape Town, South Africa, abstracts due 12 Feb 2027. The photo is not of Cape Town: it shows elephant statues in front of the Palace of the Lost City at Sun City, a resort in South Africa.
